# Anthropic Docs — All-in-one

> Combined documentation for Anthropic's API and SDKs.

## Getting started

The Anthropic API exposes the Claude family of models via a single REST endpoint. Authentication uses
an `x-api-key` header and requests are JSON. Most clients should use the official SDK rather than
raw HTTP — it handles retries, streaming, and structured tool use for you.

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
```

## Messages API

The Messages API accepts a list of role-tagged turns and returns one assistant message. System prompts
ride alongside `messages` rather than inside them, which keeps multi-turn conversations clean.

```python
client.messages.create(model="claude-opus-4-7", messages=[...])
```

## Prompt caching

Cached content is identified by a `cache_control` block on any message content. Cache hits charge a
small read fee but skip the full prompt compute cost, which makes long system prompts cheap to reuse.
